meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令行工具，帮你搭建、检查、预览并渲染视频项目；渲染前会等用户确认，遇到构建或渲染失败也会用它排查。
howto.when: 当你要创建视频项目、检查或渲染 HyperFrames 项目，或者遇到构建/渲染报错时。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 建一个示例视频项目。
say.note: 会先初始化目录并给出示例项目。

say.text: 检查这个项目的构建有没有问题，有报错就告诉我。
say.note: 会先做快速检查，再做完整检查。

say.text: 先预览，没问题再按高质量渲染成 out.mp4。
say.note: 预览通过并确认后才会渲染。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold, check, preview, and render video projects. It waits for user approval before rendering and uses the same tooling to diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to create a video project, check or render a HyperFrames project, or diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Create an example video project with HyperFrames.
say_en.note: Scaffolds a project and shows an example.

say_en.text: Check this project's build and report any errors.
say_en.note: Runs lint, then a full check.

say_en.text: Preview it, then render high quality to out.mp4 after approval.
